宽表格、代码 diff、时间轴这类横向内容，按住 Shift 快拨时同样放大位移: For horizontal content such as wide spreadsheets, code diffs and timelines, holding Shift while spinning fast magnifies the distance too. There is no horizontal smoothing, only more speed.
快速滚动时在光标旁闪一下当前倍率（如 3.2×），300 毫秒后淡出。不抢焦点、: During fast scrolling, briefly shows the current multiplier (e.g. 3.2×) next to the cursor and fades out after 300 ms. It never takes focus or catches clicks.
Windows 有时会静默摘掉钩子（表现是用着用着突然不加速）。开启后会自动发现: Windows sometimes silently removes the hook (the symptom is acceleration suddenly stopping). When on, it is detected and restored automatically, and a fresh hook is swapped in after long idle periods.

关闭后不再接管任何滚动事件（平滑也会随之失效）。: When off, no scroll events are taken over (smoothing stops working too).
每秒滚多少格以上才算「快滚」。低于它的滚动完全交给系统，一个字节都不改。调高＝更: How many notches per second count as a “fast scroll”. Below the threshold, scrolling goes entirely to the system, not one byte changed. Higher = harder to trigger; lower = a light turn accelerates.
速度到多少格/秒时倍率已经吃满上限。它与触发阈值之间是平滑过渡，不是突变。: The speed at which the multiplier reaches its cap. The transition between the trigger threshold and this point is smooth, not a jump.
相对原始滚动速度的倍数：3.0 表示滚轮拨一格，页面滚动三格的距离。: Multiple of the original scroll speed: 3.0 means one wheel notch scrolls three notches' worth.
强烈建议保持开启。关闭后往回滚时，还没发完的旧方向积压会先冲完，手感像「滚不动」: Strongly recommended to keep on. When off, scrolling back first finishes the queued distance in the old direction, which feels like the wheel is stuck.
快速甩到接近满倍率时，额外补一屏的量（约 6 格），长文档少甩几下。默认关闭：短: When a fast flick gets close to the full multiplier, adds roughly one screenful (about 6 notches), so long documents need fewer flicks. Off by default: short pages feel jumpy, and “one screen” is estimated in notches.
运行期间把系统「每次滚动几行」临时改成 1 行，退出时自动还原。适合 WPF /: Temporarily lowers the system's “lines per scroll” to 1 while running, then restores it on exit. Suits line-based windows such as WPF / WinForms / Qt: each step drops from 3 lines to 1, advancing line by line. Trade-off: the system line count is changed while it runs; if the touchpad / free-spinning wheel is handled by this app, its distance scales too. Leave it off if unsure.
细腻模式会把系统改成 1 行，退出时按这里还原。0 = 用进入前记录的原值（推荐: Fine-grained mode sets the system to 1 line and restores it on exit according to this value. 0 = use the value recorded before entry (recommended). A separate guardian process handles force-kill, crashes and shutdown.
只给系统里设过「滚轮反向」的鼠标用。正常鼠标不要开，否则上下相反。: Only for mice with “reverse wheel” enabled in Windows. Do not turn it on for a normal mouse, or up and down will be reversed.
触控板、自由滚轮通常会以 60~125Hz 连续发小步（有时看起来也是整格 12: Touchpads and free-spinning wheels usually send small steps continuously at 60–125 Hz (sometimes what looks like a full 120-unit notch). Off by default: such streams already feel like a touchpad, and frame-splitting or accelerating only breaks them up. When on, they are scaled by the multiplier; if the touchpad becomes floaty or too fast, turn it off.
这两个数字都是「速度」（格/秒），不是累计格数：滚得再多、只要慢，就永远不会加速: Both numbers are speeds (notches/s), not accumulated notches: no matter how much you scroll, if it is slow it never accelerates.
10 格/秒 ≈ 每 100ms 拨一格。正常浏览网页、看文档基本都在这个节奏以: 10 notches/s ≈ one notch every 100 ms. Ordinary web browsing and document reading stay below this pace, so it does not trigger by accident; when you want to flip through pages quickly you spin without thinking and the pace instantly reaches 20 notches/s or more.
40 格/秒 ≈ 每 25ms 拨一格，是明显的甩动。把满速点放在这里，意味着「: 40 notches/s ≈ one notch every 25 ms, a clear flick. Putting the saturation point here means “the harder you flick, the fuller the acceleration”, while a light jitter does not max it out.
3 倍是绝大多数人不需要二次调整的值：一屏变三分之一的滚动量，又不会失控到找不到: 3× is the value most people never need to change: one screenful now takes a third of the scrolling, without running away so far that you lose your place. Raise it if it feels weak; 8× is the cap.
另外，一段滚动的头 2 格、以及持续不到 70ms 的抖动，一律不加速。轻轻一拨: In addition, the first 2 notches of a scroll and jitters lasting less than 70 ms are never accelerated. A light turn is often split by the mouse into several events only milliseconds apart, which by speed looks “very fast” — this guard blocks exactly that.
不想逐个调滑块就选一个现成的：下面几档只改「跟手时间」和「惯性长度」，其余参数不: If you do not want to tune every slider, pick a preset: these only change response time and glide length; other settings stay put.

触控板曲线 + 细腻模式（每档 60px → 20px），WPF/Qt 里也能逐: Touchpad curve + fine-grained mode (60 px → 20 px per step), so WPF/Qt apps advance line by line too

一个滚轮刻度滚几行。这一项直接写进系统设置，和系统面板是同一个值：这里调多少，系: How many lines one wheel notch scrolls. This writes straight to the system setting and is the same value as the Windows panel: change it here and Windows mouse settings change too; change it there and this follows. Normally it is untouched on startup and exit — only with “Fine-grained mode” on is it temporarily set to 1 while running, then restored on exit or crash.
指针速度、左右键这些在系统面板里，这里只做跳转。: Pointer speed, left/right buttons and the like live in the Windows panel; this button just takes you there.
「所有滚动」是默认：慢慢拨一格也会被拆成几帧滑上去；「仅加速时」则只处理快滚，普: “All scrolling” is the default: even one slow notch is split into frames and glides up; “Only when accelerating” handles only fast scrolls and leaves ordinary scrolling entirely to the system.
注意：WPF / WinForms / Qt 写的程序滚动时只看方向、不看增量，: Note: programs built with WPF / WinForms / Qt read only the direction, not the delta, and scroll a fixed step per message. For them the app automatically switches to whole notches: the first notch goes out at once, then at most one per frame, so it never scrolls a whole page at once; but the framework's minimum granularity is one notch, so sub-pixel advancement like a browser is impossible.
自动跟着显示器刷新率走：屏幕多少 Hz，就每多少毫秒推一小步。: Follows the monitor refresh rate: one small step per refresh, so the interval always matches the screen's Hz.
一格（120 单位）拆成几帧发。4 表示每帧 30 单位——正好整除，老程序也不: How many frames one notch (120 units) is split into. 4 means 30 units per frame — an exact division, so old programs do not drop any. Higher is finer.
越小越跟手、越大越绵。按实测触控板节奏，40~60ms 最像：一个普通滚轮格约: Smaller feels tighter, larger feels softer. Based on measured touchpad rhythm, 40–60 ms feels most natural: one ordinary wheel notch advances continuously for about 100 ms.
只有「甩」才给惯性：慢滚一格不会飘，快甩才顺着原方向滑这么久。0 = 不额外滑行: Only flicks get glide: one slow notch does not float; a fast flick keeps gliding in the same direction for this long. 0 = no extra glide.
连续甩动时最多攒下多少格还没发。超过的部分会被丢掉，而不是「一次性全倒出去」——: How many notches may pile up unsent during repeated flicks. Anything beyond is dropped rather than dumped all at once — that dump is exactly what causes the big jump at the end of a burst of fast flicks.

决定「一格的距离怎样摊到各帧」。指数衰减是默认手感：能自然叠加连滚、渐近收尾，参: Decides how one notch's distance is spread across frames. Exponential decay is the default feel: notches blend naturally and ease out asymptotically, calibrated against a trackpad. Per-notch easing follows SmoothScroll: each notch completes in a fixed duration on the chosen curve, so the landing time is exact and the tail shape is selectable.
每一帧发「剩余量的一小部分」，可叠加、没有硬停（推荐）: Each frame emits a fraction of what is left; notches blend and never stop hard (recommended)
每一格在固定时长内走完，曲线可选；落点时间确定: Each notch completes in a fixed duration on a selectable curve; landing time is exact
五次：起手最快、尾巴最长（SmoothScroll 默认）。三次：中段更匀。指数: Quintic: fastest start, longest tail (SmoothScroll default). Cubic: more even through the middle. Exponential: fastest start, shortest tail. Linear: constant speed, the most mechanical.
一格从开始到落点走多久。越短越跟手，越长越绵；220 ms 与 SmoothSc: How long a notch takes to reach its landing point. Shorter feels more direct, longer feels softer; 220 ms matches SmoothScroll's default.
